description: What a read of the imports still running (GET /v2/uploads/active) means for the files this phone uploaded (docs/SPEC.md FR-3.2): expected is how many were running at the last read, with the uploads accepted since; acceptedSince is those accepted while this read was out, which it can't have seen. Fewer running than it could have seen means one ended, and the map is read again. Reading goes on while any runs.

cases.name: another import started meanwhile, on the web
one finished as another was accepted while the read was out
one accepted while the read was out, nothing finished
only one accepted while the read was out
